node: Multi-brand procurement consolidation and approved supplier networks
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the restaurant procurement-consolidation node finds one reference/customer anchor and three underfollowed supplier candidates. The strongest sourced chokepoint signal is that large franchisors and franchise systems can centralize or unify procurement to improve supplier leverage, consistency, and franchisee economics. Underfollowed exposure appears most plausible in private-label coffee/beverage suppliers, foodservice distributors, and private-label ingredient manufacturers that can service multiple QSR or restaurant customers across formats. Evidence strength is uneven: FARM has the clearest disclosed QSR/customer list in the provided context, WEST is a plausible B2B coffee/tea/extract supplier hypothesis, THS is a plausible private-label food supplier beneficiary, and DPZ is included only as a reference model for centralized restaurant supply-chain infrastructure.
